title: Conditional κ = 0.001677992607205282: rectangular boundary batching and radix-distributed sparse-union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001677992607205282520732088774830808372222877897034109604209719298829805473412451530867883424937597**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below, b = certified endpoint - 1e-64, with two NEW constructions (not in PR1673 or PR1699): a radix-distributed sparse-union schedule (outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md) and rectangular boundary batching with W^2 right-hand-side columns per factor page (outer/RECT-BOUNDARY.md), using the published omega(1,1,2) < 3.250035 of Alman, Duan, Vassilevska Williams, Xu, Xu, Zhou (arXiv 2404.16349) at tau_eff = omega(1,1,2) - 1 = 2.2500351 (fixed format exponent sigma = 3.2500351 strictly above the bound). The 53 strict inequalities, 9 rejecting controls (including reinstating the old union row and sigma at or below the published bound, which fail) and the endpoint rejection are regenerated with an independent balance derivation; two executable schedule simulations are run; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses; the new constructions need independent review; the exponent is a cited theorem.

Conditional kappa 0.001677992607205282520732088774830808372222877897034109604209719298829805473412451530867883424937597 (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; rectangular boundary batching outer/RECT-BOUNDARY.md, omega(1,1,2)<3.250035, tau_eff=2.2500351).
